verdict.rationale: Context.dev ships scheduled monitors that watch a page, sitemap, or structured dataset and deliver signed change events (docs-9). It also runs background batch crawls of up to 25,000 pages with progress tracking (docs-3, docs-34) and can queue brand data for prefetch (docs-31). These are real autonomous background jobs, but they are fixed, data-gathering primitives rather than general user-defined automations. Missing for 10: general automation or workflow building beyond monitoring and batch jobs, detailed docs on schedule configuration and triggered actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that monitors run reliably.
